description: This file defines the 'Interview' entity class for the Human Resource Management system. It contains properties and methods related to interview details, associations with candidates, vacancies, and interviewers, and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: Interview
classes.description: Entity class representing an interview in the recruitment module, with properties for interview details, associated candidate and vacancy, interviewers, and ORM mappings.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the interview.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the interview.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Returns the associated CandidateVacancy entity, if any.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Associates a CandidateVacancy entity with this interview.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the candidate associated with the interview.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate entity with this interview.

methods.name: getInterviewName
methods.description: Returns the name/title of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewName
methods.description: Sets the name/title of the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewDate
methods.description: Returns the scheduled date of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewDate
methods.description: Sets the scheduled date of the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled time of the interview.

methods.name: setInterviewTime
methods.description: Sets the scheduled time of the interview.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns any notes associated with the interview.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Adds or updates notes for the interview.

methods.name: getInterviewers
methods.description: Returns the list of interviewers assigned to this interview.
